note: Register entries from the 2026-08-05 Bucaco pass that did not ship. All 29 ICNF-classified entries in the concelho of Mealhada stand inside the Mata Nacional do Bucaco; 6 page entries were published from 7 processos, 15 are leads and 7 are blocked. Never rendered. ICNF girths and heights are in METRES and every age is the age at the last measurement, so add the years since. The register's 29 is not a count of what exists: the Fundacao Mata do Bucaco counted 86 notable trees before the 2013 cyclone, and the 2018 classification decree covered 26 trees and 4 groupings, which does not reconcile with the 29 rows here either.

folded_twins.why: Two Sequoia sempervirens 10 m apart at 40.37580/-8.36147 and 40.37589/-8.36147, both 45 m tall, girths 5.64 m and 5.67 m, both recorded as standing in front of the Ermida de Santo Elias. One visitor sight, so one entry.

leads.name: Cedro-do-Bucaco at the Passo da 1a Queda
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - Junto ao Passo da 1.ª Queda
leads.why: [RESOLVED 2026-08-13, delivered as bsc_007] The best unshipped tree here and the first one a next pass should chase. Register gives 300 years at the 2016 measurement, so about 310 now, with a 5.26 m trunk and 31 m of height, which would make it the second oldest thing in the forest after the Cedro de Sao Jose and, unlike that one, structurally intact. Cut only because no independent source names this individual tree: the Portuguese coverage of Bucaco cypresses is all about the Sao Jose specimen. A single confirming source, most likely the Fundacao Mata do Bucaco's own trail material, ships it.

leads.name: Pedunculate Oak by the Capela de Sao Pedro
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - Junto Á Capela de S.Pedro
leads.why: [RESOLVED 2026-08-13, delivered as bsc_008] Register gives 300 years at the 2016 measurement, so about 310 now, girth 4.92 m, height 24 m, crown 20.7 m. One of only two natives on the classified list and it would balance a page otherwise made entirely of imports. No independent source found for the individual tree in the time available.

leads.name: Redwood at the Fonte de Santa Teresa
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - no talude, junto à Fonte de Santa Teresa
leads.why: Girth 5.58 m, 45 m tall, 150 years at the 2016 measurement, on the Trilho da Agua past the historic fountains. Note for the record: its girth is actually comparable to, not bigger than, the bsc_005 pair (5.64m/5.67m per that entry's own notes), so the story does not repeat that claim. Previously cut on the count and on 'three redwoods make a list, not a walk', which CLAUDE.md's Step 2 names as exactly the kind of judgement call that must never block publication; shipped once that was noticed.

leads.name: Redwood near the Porta das Lapas
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - a 70 m da Porta das Lapas, no caminho para o Lago Grande
leads.why: Girth 5.04 m, 45 m tall, no age recorded. Register places it 70 m from the Porta das Lapas on the path to the Lago Grande, which is the far west of the walled forest, about 450 m off the published walk. Cut on distance and count.

leads.name: Redwood on the bend at the head of the Vale de Sao Silvestre
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - no cimo do Vale de São Silvestre, na curva da estrada
leads.why: Girth 4.67 m and 56 m tall, the tallest redwood in the register here, 147 years at 2016. Registered as tipo Alameda, so it may be one of a row rather than a single tree, which has to be resolved on the ground before it could ship as a collectible point. Ten metres from King Regnans, so it may in practice be part of that stop.

leads.name: American Ash at the Largo do Mosteiro
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - Largo do Mosteiro (junto à Loja da Mata)
leads.why: Girth 4.65 m, 24 m tall, crown 26 m wide, 136 years at 2016. Stands right by the Loja da Mata, so it is on the walk anyway and costs nothing to add. Cut for lack of a second source and because the Largo do Mosteiro already contributes two published entries.

leads.name: Sycamore Maple by the Lago da Fonte
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do  Buçaco - junto ao Lago da Fonte
leads.why: The best best_time candidate in Bucaco and the only obvious one: 36 m of deciduous tree at 100 years in 2016, so genuine autumn colour in a forest whose published trees are all evergreen. Cut for lack of a second source. Worth chasing precisely because this page carries no seasonal peak at all.

leads.name: Cork Oak on the south slope of the Lago Grande
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do  Buçaco - na encosta a Sul do Lago Grande
leads.why: [RESOLVED 2026-08-13, delivered as bsc_009] Girth 4.26 m, 17.5 m tall, no age in the register. A native cork oak inside a collection of exotics, and cork oak is the Portuguese tree, so the story writes itself. No second source and no age; 400 m west of the published walk.

leads.name: Til by the Lago Grande
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do  Buçaco - junto ao Lago Grande
leads.why: Ocotea foetens, the til of the Madeiran and Canarian laurel forests, 38 m tall with a 3 m trunk. A relict laurisilva species growing on the mainland is a genuinely unusual thing to stand in front of. No age recorded, no second source.

leads.name: Cedro-do-Bucaco by the Passo de Anas
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - Junto ao Passo de Anás
leads.why: Girth 3.68 m, 27 m tall, crown 19 m, no age recorded. Undated and smaller than the other cypresses; on the Via Sacra path so easy to fold into a future walk.

leads.name: Cedro-do-Bucaco by the ruin of the Ermida do Sacramento
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - Junto à ruina da Ermida do Sacramento (a 30 m do Passo de Anás)
leads.why: Girth 4.2 m, 27 m tall, crown 20.2 m, no age. Standing beside a ruined hermitage 30 m from the Passo de Anas, which is a good setting. Undated and single-sourced.

leads.name: Cedro-do-Bucaco east of the Casa de Guarda do Serpa
leads.register_place: MN Buçaco - junto a um caminho florestal, cerca de 200 m a E da Casa de Guarda do Serpa
leads.why: Girth 4.72 m, 35 m tall, 100 years. Not part of the 2018 classification decree (no classified date in the register), so its protected status differs from the rest and needs checking. About 200 m east of a forest guard house on a forest track, at the north edge of the cluster.

leads.name: Mexican White Pine at the Cova da Raposa
leads.why: Pinus ayacahuite, girth 2.55 m, 40 m tall, 100 years. Not in the 2018 decree. Modest trunk; ships only if a story turns up.

leads.name: Mexican White Pine behind the Passo de Anas
leads.register_place: MN Buçaco - Junto ao caminho, por trás do Passo de Anás
leads.why: REGISTER DATA ERROR, do not repeat the figure. The register gives height 100 m against a girth of 1.95 m, which is physically impossible and would beat every tree in Europe. Almost certainly a decimal or unit slip for 10.0 m. Recorded here so a future pass does not rediscover it as a sensation.

leads.name: Magenta Cherry at the nursery entrance
leads.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - à entrada do viveiro florestal
leads.why: Syzygium paniculatum, girth 3.15 m, crown 9.4 m, no height and no age recorded. An Australian rainforest tree with edible magenta fruit, which would be a real fruit best_time if a source dated the season here. Too thin as it stands.

blocked.name: Adernal and other species at the Cruz Alta
blocked.species: Phillyrea latifolia L. e outras espécies
blocked.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - Cruz Alta
blocked.reason: A mixed stand of Phillyrea latifolia and other species, registered as a conjunto arboreo. Not one identifiable tree and there is no single place to stand, so it fails the collectible-point test outright. Worth knowing anyway: the adernal is a habitat whose world distribution is a few hectares here, which is a fact for the city intro, not an entry.

blocked.name: Tree ferns of the Vale de Sao Silvestre
blocked.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - Vale de São Silvestre
blocked.reason: An alameda of Dicksonia antarctica. A run of tree ferns along a valley, not one tree, and a tree fern is not a tree. Non-collectible point.

blocked.name: Tree ferns of the Rua dos Fetos
blocked.register_place: Mata Nacional do Buçaco - Rua dos Fetos
blocked.reason: An alameda of Dicksonia antarctica along a named path. Same reason: a stretch of path, not a point, and nothing to stand at.

blocked.name: The seven green ashes of the Largo da Fonte Fria
blocked.register_place: MN Buçaco - Largo da Fonte Fria
blocked.reason: Registered as an alameda of seven Fraxinus pennsylvanica with averaged dimensions. Seven trees around a square is not one identifiable tree.

blocked.name: The eight Atlas cedars east of the Largo da Fonte Fria
blocked.register_place: MN Buçaco - Na berma da Estrada da Mata (a E do Largo da Fonte Fria)
blocked.reason: An alameda of eight Cedrus atlantica along a road verge, dimensions averaged across the row. An avenue, explicitly non-collectible.

blocked.register_place: MN Buçaco - Na berma da Estrada da Mata (a W do Largo da Fonte Fria)
blocked.reason: An alameda of seven Cedrus atlantica along the same road verge. Same reason.

blocked.register_place: MN Buçaco - Na berma da Estrada da Mata (mais a W do Largo da Fonte Fria)
